good: Real wall takedowns: rival ('NIGHTFALL') flips and wrecks, big TAKEDOWN! banner, counter 01->04, boost recharged
Cohesive low-poly sunset coastal-highway art direction with actual bends, kerbs, barriers, gantry signs, fog
Burnout-style HUD that lives: huge speed numeral (069->403), boost bar, takedown count, CRASHED/TAKEDOWN/FULL SEND callouts
bad: Scripted drive smashed into barriers on almost every input phase; walls feel brutally unforgiving
No idle state - car rolls on with zero keys held
Flat-shaded blocks give limited speed sensation; automated steer check still failed
step-5-preview.one_line: A sharp-looking little low-poly duel with genuinely satisfying takedowns and a proper Burnout HUD, if you can keep it off the walls.

good: Winding coastal road with real bends, a chase camera that stays behind the car, and speeds up to 400 km/h
Clear Burnout-like HUD: big speed number, boost bar, takedown counter, rival panel, and TAKEDOWN!/CRASHED banners
Trailer shows 4 takedowns with sparks and the rival flipping into the wall
bad: In the scripted drive the car hits the wall very often, and the takedown counter stays at 00
D steering is hard to confirm because the car is still recovering from a crash in the right-steer frames
The low-poly look is clean but flat, and the rival wreck is small and hard to read in many frames
opus-5.5-high.one_line: Looks like a polished low-poly Burnout tribute with satisfying takedowns, but you will kiss the guardrail a lot before you learn the handling.

good: Winding coastal road with real bends, speeds over 300 km/h, camera stays behind the car
Takedowns are readable: big TAKEDOWN! banner, sparks, rival flips, counter goes up
Burnout-style HUD with big speed number, boost bar, takedown count and a rival panel
bad: Steering is too sharp: in the scripted drive the car hits the wall and shows CRASHED again and again
No takedowns in the scripted play, so you only see them in the trailer
Flat low-poly world with plain box-shaped cars, and the HUD text is small and hard to read
opus-5.5.one_line: Looks and plays like a real mini-Burnout with good takedowns, but you will hit the walls more often than the rival does.

good: Real takedowns: spark burst, wrecked rival, TAKEDOWN! banner and counter ticking 01-04
Burnout-style HUD with big speed, segmented boost bar and rival 'NIGHTFALL' indicator
Camera stays glued behind the car and the stylized coastal highway world is cohesive
bad: Road is a wide multi-lane highway with gentle sweeps, not the tight drifting corners the brief asked for
Scripted drive crashes into walls constantly (3+ crashes in free play), steering/drift feels twitchy and unforgiving
Cars are simple toy-like boxes and the low-poly world reads somewhat generic
deepseek-v4.1-flash.one_line: It genuinely nails the takedown moment and Burnout HUD, but the track is a flat-out highway rather than a corner-carving duel, and the car spends half the run bouncing off walls.

good: cohesive low-poly coastal world with lighting and billboards
full Burnout HUD with big speed boost bar and takedown counter
trailer shows 4x TAKEDOWN! with sparks and wrecked rival
bad: road is fast sweeps only no tight corners to drift
steering is twitchy and ends in CRASHED wall hits
scripted drive never triggers a takedown
muse-spark-1.3-contributor.one_line: Looks slick and drifts but mostly blasts down a straight highway until you wall it.
